title: Magic-wand lasso produces bounding-box rectangle instead of pixel-contour polygon
description: selectedPixelsToBoundingPolygon in StageArea.tsx produces only an AABB rectangle for all smoothing levels. Flash 8's magic-wand lasso traces visible pixel contours (Marching Squares algorithm) and smooth mode applies corner-rounding. Without this, lasso cuts the entire bounding box instead of the pixel shape.
